'''Sargon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|Army]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sargon appeared as a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
